lines.en: I peek in through the gap in the door.

lines.zh: 我只有半个身子露在外
lines.en: Only half of me shows.
I shift slowly to the window.
When you look, I pull back.
I show a little more of myself.
I'm always just out of place.
I slip behind the curtain.
No footprints follow me.
I move along the wall's edge.
I never quite come all the way in.
I lean out, then draw back.

lines.zh: 你转头的速度慢了一点
lines.en: Your head turns a little too slowly.
Only one of my eyes shows.
I stand behind the door, silent.
You saw me, and aren't sure.
I've been in that corner all along.
Half of me is in the light.
You can't count how often I've shown.
I tilt my head slightly.
I watch you; you look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有一个多余的人
lines.en: There's one extra person in this room.
I wait for you to check again.
I never step into the light.
My shadow is only half there.
I stand against the door frame.
You've begun to distrust your eyes.
What you saw might be real.
I poke my head out from behind the door.
You blink, and I'm gone.
Look again, and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我不知道你为什么停下
lines.en: I don't know why you stopped.
Only half my face shows.
You're deciding whether to come closer.
I won't step out.
You come forward; I recede.
It isn't hiding. Only letting you look.
Your hand stops on the handle.
Don't look at my lower half.
You're looking already.

lines.zh: 你看到的和我看到的不同
lines.en: What you see isn't what I see.
You step back; I keep peeking.
This crack is all that's between us.
Do you want to pull the door open?
I'd advise against it.
You'd see more than you want.
Now. Watch the gap.
The door panel takes a hit.
I retreat half an inch.
You hit the door.
My gaze hasn't moved.
That much noise is nothing.
I'm still behind the gap.
You heard me laugh once.
It was very quiet.
I've shown a little more of myself.
Do you want to try again?
I don't intend to come in.
I don't need what you're holding.
I only look from this side of the gap.
Put it down. Perhaps then.
I've drawn back; you can't see me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不想要。
lines.en: I do not want what you hold.
I only look. I don't eat.
Put it away; do not show me.
Reach out and I'll pull back.
We keep this distance.
You hit the half-open door.
I've been on the other side.
My hand reaches through the gap.
It's very cold to the touch.
You back off; the door still swings.
I stand against the door panel.
A layer of wood lies between us.
You've shut the door.
Shutting it doesn't help.
I'm still outside, watching.
I only want to watch you.

lines.zh: 我不进来，你也不用出来
lines.en: I won't come in, and you needn't come out.
Through the door is enough.
Stay, and I'll be right here.
I don't need more than this.
The gap will always be there.
You needn't look at my face.
And I won't look at yours.
This is good. Don't change it.
Leaving? The door stays open.
I put out half a hand.
I can't reach; I pull it back.
It rolled to the edge of the gap.
I pushed it to your side.
I don't want it. Only curious.
Pick it up and look.
My fingers never touched it.
It's still where it was.
You saw it move.
Light comes through the gap.
You finally noticed the door.
I'm right behind this gap.
Your steps this way are very soft.
I know you're hesitating.
How much courage have you?

lines.zh: 门缝里，只有一只眼看你。
lines.en: Through the gap, only one eye.
You heard the wood creak.
Still and silent, only watching
You've put your hand on the door.
You mean to push it open.
I'll step aside a little.
And then you'll see clearly.
I didn't intend for this.
You walked over yourself.
I did warn you.
It's too late now.
I keep half a step of distance.
The gap hasn't changed width.
You inside, me outside.
You step back, and the door opens a little.
That isn't the wind.
You hear the wood groaning.
I've drawn my fingers back in.

lines.zh: 你不再确定看见了什么
lines.en: You're no longer sure what you saw.
I show myself a little more.
You're backing away.
The light in the room dims.
The gap has grown wider.
I didn't do that.
You heard a second sound.
That one was nearer.
I've turned my face square on.
Are you waiting for me to speak?
I can't form the words.
Now. Come closer.
Let me see you clearly.
I push the door.
The door's edge catches you.

lines.zh: 我的手指从缝里伸进来
lines.en: My fingers come through the gap.
It was only a light touch.
You aren't hurt, are you?
The door shut by itself.
You're caught between wall and door.
I haven't stepped in.
You hear the wood splitting.
The crack has widened a little.
The hand reaches farther.
I've stopped.
Now you should decide.
Push it, or step back.
I can wait either way.
You have no other choice.
The gap holds a little more darkness.

lines.zh: 我在你没有关严的门后
lines.en: I'm behind the door you left ajar.

lines.zh: 你刚才听见的那声，是我
lines.en: That sound you heard — it was me.
First I show half a face.
The light falls from this side.
When you looked, I withdrew half an inch.
This room's door was shut before.
Now it stands ajar.
I didn't push anything.
Did you hear the breathing?
It was very shallow.
I only came to look.
You wouldn't like me to come in.
So I stay at the gap.
You've started looking already.
Stare too long and I come closer.
The eyes get used to things.
And then you stop being afraid.
That would be a shame.

lines.zh: 门缝那道黑影，一直没走。
lines.en: The dark shape in the door gap never left.
The firelight makes the gap very bright.
I slide down out of the door frame.
Water seeps in through the gap.
The blast bangs the door open a foot.
The arrow sticks in the door frame.
This light sweeps across the gap.

lines.zh: 幻觉没有肠胃，饿不起来。
lines.en: A hallucination has no gut to hunger with.
Lightning lights the whole corridor.
There's nothing behind the door now.
